## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger, the previous behavior and the resulting behavior.

## Scope and compatibility

State affected application/platform/UI boundaries and any CLI, identity/KV, media, dependency or package impact.

## Validation

List actual commands, configurations and results. Separate host checks, cross-compilation/ABI/package checks and hardware results. Name checks not run and the reason.

## Remaining work

Note outstanding hardware scenarios or migration requirements. Update documentation, changelog, dependency provenance and the validation matrix when affected. Remove credentials and private identifiers from logs.
